returned.name: list_workspaces
returned.description: Lists all active engineering workspaces and product workspaces.

returned.name: create_workspace
returned.description: Creates a new engineering workspace for design generation, simulation, and artifacts.

returned.name: get_workspace_status
returned.description: Returns status, directories, design counts, and simulation history of a workspace.

returned.name: list_products
returned.description: Lists all authoritative engineering products stored in SQLite.

returned.name: create_product
returned.description: Creates a new authoritative engineering product and initial baseline revision.

returned.name: validate_specification
returned.description: Validates electrical operating parameters against SI schema and physical constraints.

spec_data.description: Electrical specification object containing vin_nom_v, vout_v, iout_a, etc.

returned.name: save_specification
returned.description: Persists an updated electrical specification to a product revision.

returned.name: generate_design
returned.description: Synthesizes candidate converter topologies, sizes components, and generates native CAD artifacts (.kicad_sch, .kicad_pcb, .asc, .net, .step).

returned.name: get_design
returned.description: Retrieves synthesized engineering design details, component values, and topology.

returned.name: list_design_candidates
returned.description: Lists all candidate topologies synthesized for an engineering design with feasibility scores.

returned.name: run_engineering_calculations
returned.description: Executes first-principles deterministic engineering calculations: 'dowell' (winding losses), 'losses' (MOSFET switching/conduction), 'steinmetz' (core loss), or 'flyback' (transformer sizing).

returned.name: run_simulation
returned.description: Executes headless industrial simulation (LTspice transient or FEMM magnetics) on generated netlists.

netlist_name.description: Optional specific netlist (.net / .cir) or script (.lua) filename

returned.name: list_simulations
returned.description: Lists simulation jobs and execution status.

returned.name: list_design_artifacts
returned.description: Lists all CAD schematics (.kicad_sch), PCB layouts (.kicad_pcb), SPICE netlists (.asc/.net), 3D STEP solids (.step), and simulation waveforms (.raw) in a workspace.

returned.name: open_artifact
returned.description: Opens a native design artifact in the host's specialized CAD application (KiCad, LTspice, or FreeCAD).

returned.name: list_tools
returned.description: Lists external host engineering tools (LTspice, KiCad, FEMM, FreeCAD) and their operational status.

returned.name: check_tool
returned.description: Performs a live diagnostic health check on an engineering tool.

returned.name: open_tool_file
returned.description: Launches a native tool directly with a specified engineering file.

returned.name: list_revisions
returned.description: Lists all revision snapshots and specification hashes for a product.

returned.name: create_revision
returned.description: Creates a new immutable revision baseline for a product.

returned.name: get_validation_summary
returned.description: Returns formal engineering validation summary and gate status for a revision.

returned.name: generate_engineering_report
returned.description: Generates a formal, immutable engineering dossier report (HTML + JSON snapshot with SHA-256).

revision_id.description: Product revision UUID (optional; defaults to first active)
